package.name: crusader_groundstation
package.description:
The operator's window onto the boat: one web page, served from the Jetson, that shows what is running, what the sensors say, where the boat and its targets are, and how to power the machine down. The laptop needs a browser and nothing else.
The one package allowed to KNOW ABOUT every other package - it names their nodes in order to launch them - while IMPORTING none of them. That is what keeps it off the dependency graph of the code it starts.
